report:
Bilateral fallopian tubes and ovaries, risk-reducing bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy

Received in formalin is a risk-reducing bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy specimen. The right fallopian tube measures 5 x 0.6 cm and the left fallopian tube 4.5 x 0.5 cm, both with fimbriated ends. The right ovary measures 2.5 x 1.5 x 1 cm and the left ovary 2 x 1.5 x 1 cm, with unremarkable cut surfaces. The fimbriated ends are amputated and sectioned longitudinally, and the remaining tubes and the ovaries are sectioned serially (SEE-FIM protocol). All embedded in 10 blocks.

(1) Left fimbria, longitudinal sections. (2-3) Left fallopian tube, cross sections. (4-5) Left ovary. (6) Right fimbria, longitudinal sections. (7-8) Right fallopian tube, cross sections. (9-10) Right ovary.

Sections show fimbrial tissue and cross sections of both fallopian tubes with unremarkable plicae. The fallopian tube epithelium shows a wild-type expression pattern on immunohistochemistry for p53. Only scattered cells are positive for Ki-67. The ovaries are unremarkable. There is no evidence of malignancy or serous tubal intraepithelial carcinoma (STIC).

BILATERAL FALLOPIAN TUBES AND OVARIES, risk-reducing bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy - NO EVIDENCE OF MALIGNANCY OR STIC
